svg.title: Green Panel with Orange Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Observed green square at upper left joined to orange curved triangular panel on right. Surrounding open corners are transparent; physical aspect from current museum object metadata.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://collection.cincinnatiartmuseum.org/objects/5722/green-panel-with-orange-curve; source object 1996.447; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
